name: Adriana, Captain of the Guard
description: A captain of the guard skeptical of rulers who need protection.

description_citations.text: Commander Masters: card flavor text (Commander Masters, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Adriana pledges her sword to the city's defense, not the throne or the usurper.
timeline.quote: My sword is pledged to the defense of this city, not to the throne or this usurper.

citation.text: Adriana, Captain of the Guard (Conspiracy: Take the Crown, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Adriana warns that Marchesa's poison is delivered by more than daggers and calls her a usurper.
relations.quote: Marchesa's poison is delivered by more than daggers.

citation.text: Garrulous Sycophant (Conspiracy: Take the Crown, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
